title: Conversation-cache budget 4096 -> 8192 MiB (c2 follow-up; documented cap)
inspiration: DeepInfer: 72h KV persistence. Strata docs: default 40% free RAM capped at 8 GiB - 8192 is the documented ceiling.
evidence: MEASURED 2026-10-31 (post-C2 evening): 1450 'skip parking (... exceeds)' lines in the current engine log - now total-budget rejections, not per-snapshot: parked bytes reach 2.8-3.4 GiB from SINGLE sessions (parked 210552 tokens -> snapshot_bytes 3438997384 = 3.44 GB; ~16.5 KiB/token at k8v4). 12-14 explicit cache evictions followed. Cost of the eviction cycle is directly visible: 191 requests with >=100k cold re-read = 6729 s of GPU prefill in 2.5 days (37% of all 18058 prefill seconds); 27 requests >=200k tokens each costing 55-112 s of re-prefill. Machine currently has 42.3 GiB free RAM; 8192 MiB = 19% of free.
conditions: pairs naturally with C5 (prompt-cache-spread: history rewrites currently force the cold 250k re-reads that then consume parking budget). Keep min-free-mib guard (2560). Watch that free RAM does not trend below 4 GiB over 24h.
acceptance: budget 'exceeds' skip lines -> ~0 with 8 GiB (projected from observed parked-set ~5-6 GB); evictions/day < 2; cold re-read >=100k seconds drop >=50% over matched 48h windows (audit + log parse); no swap pressure.
verdict: PENDING - needs a cutover window (user consent).
